title: keystore-rotation-and-vuln-prioritization-sync-2027-05-06
content:
Meeting: Security Engineering Sync — Keystore rotation, vuln prioritization, threat-modeling checkins
Date: 2027-05-06
Organizer: Aisha Patel (sec-eng)
Attendees: Aisha Patel, Miguel Ortega, Priya Desai, Liam OConnor, Sana Rahman, Ben Cho (SRE guest)
Duration: 45m
Location: Zoom / #sec-eng

Purpose: quick cadence for coordinating an upcoming keystore/HSM rotation, reconcile the vuln backlog with customer-facing risk, and capture new threat-modeling inputs for third-party plugin integration. This doc captures notes, decisions, and action items; tag owners in Linear for follow-up.

Agenda:
- Current keystore/HSM rotation status and blockers
- High-priority vulnerability triage summary (customer impact + mitigation plan)
- Secrets inventory gaps found during on-call rotation
- Threat model addenda for third-party plugin system
- Action items and owners

Notes:
1) Keystore/HSM rotation
- Progress: Ben confirmed the staging HSM rotation ran Monday night (staging 100% complete). Prod rotation plan is in Linear (RED-2314).
- Blockers: Ops automation script (infra/keystore-rotate) fails for long-lived enrollment tokens when run from the bastion (timeout + retry behavior). Miguel traced failure to SSH jump proxy rate limiting; temporary mitigation is to use a dedicated rotation worker with longer retries.
- Risk: If rotation is delayed past 2027-05-20 (scheduled cutoff for old key deprecation), a handful of clients with pinned cert chains will see auth errors. Customer Success has flagged two enterprise customers on the rotation calendar next week.
- Decision: proceed with staged rollout using the rotation worker approach; do not run bulk rotations from bastion until proxy rate limiting is mitigated.

2) Vulnerability triage summary (top items)
- RED-4312 (medium-high): dependency grpc-java 1.56.x – remote crash issue when malformed proto is received. Affects hosted-api routing microservice. Exploit surface: low because gateway validates payloads, but internal fuzzer found crash case. Action: upgrade to 1.56.3 with patched deserialization behavior; deploy to canary within 48h. Owner: Priya.
- RED-4398 (high): JAR signing verification bypass in third-party tokenizer library used in model preprocessing. Proof-of-concept available in internal sandbox. Customer exposure: any pipeline that pulls external tokenizer releases. Action: pin tokenizer to vetted SHA, block external fetch in build pipeline, start remediation PR to vendor. Owner: Miguel.
- RED-4420 (critical - elevated): leaked static AWS credentials found in archived logs (S3 lifecycle backup snapshots). Credentials are expired but cover an admin role. Impact: moderate if attacker finds historical snapshots. Action: rotate affected IAM keys (complete), rotate keystore entries that used the keys, notify audit/compliance, and add automated scan for creds in archived snapshots. Owner: Aisha. Deadline: immediate (in progress).

3) Secrets inventory & mapping findings
- During on-call handover, we discovered two Helm charts in legacy k8s-apps that referenced a non-KMS secret named legacy-service-token. This token is still live in one staging namespace. Action: create ticket to replace with KMS-backed reference and mark for revocation post-test. Owner: Liam. Due: 2027-05-13.
- Observation: Developer laptops using dev environment CLI were caching service tokens in ~/.cache/ri-cli/session.json for 7 days. Proposal: reduce default TTL to 1 hour for dev builds and update docs. Action: add to CLI backlog; tag dx-owner. Owner: Sana.

4) Threat modeling: third-party plugin integration (notes)
- Context: Product wants to allow vetted plugins to run lightweight model transforms in a sandboxed runtime. Threat surface additions: exfil via plugin logs, OOB network calls, plugin-supplied model weights, side-channel via GPU timing.
- Mitigations discussed: enforce egress-only whitelist through policy, mandatory code signing for plugin bundles, sandboxed syscalls with seccomp profiles, per-plugin ephemeral credentials (rotated on each invocation), and mandatory offline scanning of plugin artifacts for secrets.
- Decision: create a focused threat-model doc (Confluence) with proposed mitigations and measurable acceptance criteria (no egress without allowlist, no write to persistent storage). Owner: Sana to draft.

Open questions and risks:
- How to audit archived S3 snapshots at scale for leaked credentials? Priya suggested leveraging existing lambda-scan job but it needs expansion to handle gzip/tar blobs.
- What is the customer communication plan if a keystore rotation causes auth failures? CS should prepare a rollback playbook and a customer notification template.
- Are we comfortable with the current KMS key material lifecycles for Dedicated customers who have BYOK (bring your own key)? Need legal/enterprise input.

Decisions made during the meeting:
- Use dedicated rotation worker approach for prod keystore rotation; do not run bulk rotation from bastion until proxy fix. (Aisha, Ben)
- Immediate rotation of expired-but-recorded AWS keys and post-rotation audit pipeline. (Aisha)
- Vendor pinning and blocking of external tokenizer fetches pending vendor response. (Miguel)

Action items (explicit):
- RED-2314: Deploy keystore rotation worker to prod, add retry/backoff tuning. Owner: Miguel. Due: 2027-05-12.
- Upgrade grpc-java to patched version and schedule canary rollout. Owner: Priya. Due: 2027-05-08.
- Create remediation PR to pin tokenizer library and block external fetches in CI. Owner: Miguel. Due: 2027-05-09.
- Rotate IAM keys discovered in archived snapshots; run audit and post findings to audit log. Owner: Aisha. Due: 2027-05-07 (in progress).
- Replace legacy-service-token in Helm charts with KMS-backed secret reference and revoke token. Owner: Liam. Due: 2027-05-13.
- Reduce dev CLI default token TTL to 1 hour and update developer docs. Owner: Sana. Due: 2027-05-20.
- Draft plugin threat model with acceptance criteria and controls. Owner: Sana. Due: 2027-05-14.
- Expand archived-snapshot credential scanner to handle compressed backups; prototype Lambda job. Owner: Priya. Due: 2027-05-21.
- CS to draft customer rotation communication template + rollback playbook and attach to RED-2314. Owner: Ben (CS liaison). Due: 2027-05-11.

Follow-ups / next sync:
- Quick check-in on keystore rotation on Monday (2027-05-10) at 09:00 PT — short standup in #sec-eng-ops.
- Full triage review next weekly sync (2027-05-13) to verify remediation PRs and canary results.

Notes to self / capture for audit:
- Keep copies of rotation logs (signed) for 90 days; store in audit S3 with restricted access.
- Log format for rotation worker should include pre-rotation fingerprint, rotated key id, actor id, and rotation job id to facilitate rollback if needed.

References and useful links:
- Keystore rotation playbook: https://confluence.redwood.com/display/SEC/keystore-rotation-playbook
- Linear tickets: RED-2314 (keystore rotation), RED-4398 (tokenizer vuln), RED-4420 (archived creds)
- Infra PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/842

End of notes.
